instruction: Explain the steps to enable single-window mode in GIMP, so every tool and dialog is contained within a single window.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling single-window mode in GIMP. The evaluator checks the sessionrc config file for the 'single-window-mode' setting being set to 'yes'. This is a similar difficulty task to the original - it requires navigating GIMP menus (Windows > Single-Window Mode) to enable the setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GIMP sessionrc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/sessionrc
Metric function correctly parses GIMP config format: skips comments/empty lines, parses (key value) syntax
Expected value 'yes' is semantically correct for GIMP's single-window-mode setting format
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure session settings are written to disk
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling single-window mode, evaluator checks exactly that setting
Logical correctness: metric checks both key match (single-window-mode) and value match (yes) correctly
Data flow is correct: agent enables setting -> GIMP closed -> config saved -> getter reads file -> metric verifies setting
